verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several ways to run Claude Code unattended: scheduled runs for recurring work like morning PR reviews, overnight CI failure analysis and weekly dependency audits, plus desktop scheduling of recurring tasks. They also cover long-running cloud sessions you check back on later, CI automation via GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD, automatic review on every PR, and MCP channels that react to webhooks or chat messages while you're away. The sandbox is documented as enabling more autonomous execution. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how schedules and triggers are configured (evidence is overview-level only), independent or hands-on corroboration that background automations run reliably.
